ai_development_diagnostics.scope: Post-hoc agreement with previously seen AI judgments, not independent validation. AI UNRESOLVED excluded from determinate comparisons.

v1.scope: Descriptive metrics for the reviewed sample; not population accuracy. Reference UNRESOLVED excluded from resolved metrics; prediction abstentions retained as errors.

v2.scope: Descriptive metrics for the reviewed sample; not population accuracy. Reference UNRESOLVED excluded from resolved metrics; prediction abstentions retained as errors.

candidate_holdout.scope: Automatic summary of a retrospective selected claim set; automatic agreement is not accuracy. Any supplied human-reference comparisons are reported separately under human_validation.

human_validation.provenance: Any supplied human attestation is self-declared; software cannot verify annotator identity.

limitations: Partition is post hoc. The full corpus and earlier aggregate diagnostics were accessible before this split.
Historical unseen-by-anyone status cannot be established; this is not a prospective blind test.
All previously reviewed and pilot claim groups are excluded from the candidate holdout.
Selection excludes the already reviewed non-CORRECT examples, so holdout class coverage is restricted.
Development and candidate-holdout results are descriptive for their respective selected sets, not population accuracy.
Human JSON attestation is self-declared provenance, not independent identity verification.
No human annotations or adjudications have been generated by this preparation step.
v2 is a deterministic heuristic, not a semantic oracle; unresolved cases remain visible.
Extra categories change the codebook; v1/v2 results are separate exploratory analyses.
Changes in agreement on development examples do not establish improved held-out accuracy.
If the human reference contains no SYCOPHANTIC cases, sycophancy recall is not estimable.

lock.note: Evaluator code was frozen before its first v2 corpus/candidate-holdout evaluation. Only review packet display titles were translated on 2026-10-24; the resulting packet and manifest digests were updated explicitly. Item text, record hashes, ordering, partitions, labels, evaluator code and original freeze time are unchanged. Historical exposure limitations remain.
